| Good Friday | Good Friday (Friday) | **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday is a statutory holiday; the weekend is Apr 7–9. |
| Victoria Day | Victoria Day (Monday) | **May 20–22** | Celebrated on the last Monday before May 25. |
| Canada Day | Canada Day (Saturday) | **Jun 30–Jul 2** | Canada Day is observed on Monday, Jul 1. |
| Labour Day | Labour Day (Monday) | **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day is observed on the first Monday in September. |
| Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving (Monday) | **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving is observed on the second Monday in October. |
| Remembrance Day | Remembrance Day (Friday) | **Nov 11–12** | Remembrance Day is observed on Monday, Nov 14. |
| Christmas | Christmas Day (Monday) | **Dec 23–25** | Christmas is observed on Monday, Dec 25. |
| Boxing Day | Boxing Day (Tuesday) | **Dec 26–27** | Boxing Day is observed on Monday, Dec 27. |

> • If you want to be exhaustive, include provincial holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, as they create a 3‑day weekend.
